title: Profile Setup: require bank details before OTP and bind OTP state to bank selection

requirements.summary: Require selecting a bank and entering bank account number (plus mobile) before allowing OTP request, with clear English messaging when missing.
acceptanceCriteria: On ProfileSetupScreen, the “Send OTP” button is disabled until (a) a bank is selected and (b) bank account number is non-empty and (c) mobile number is non-empty.
If the user attempts to request OTP without selecting a bank (e.g., by any alternate UI path), the UI shows an English error toast/message that explicitly says to select a bank first.

file_operations.description: Update OTP request gating so “Send OTP” is disabled unless selectedBank is non-empty, bankAccountNumber is non-empty, and mobileNumber is non-empty (in addition to existing in-flight/requested conditions). Add explicit guard(s) inside handleSendOtp to prevent OTP requests when bank is not selected (or when required fields are missing), and show an English toast that explicitly instructs the user to select a bank first. Keep all user-facing copy in English.

requirements.summary: Reset OTP requested/verified/code state when selected bank or bank account number changes (in addition to existing mobile-number reset).
acceptanceCriteria: If the user has requested an OTP and then changes the selected bank, the UI clears OTP input state (requested/verified/code/demo code) and requires requesting a new OTP.
If the user has requested an OTP and then changes the bank account number, the UI clears OTP input state (requested/verified/code/demo code) and requires requesting a new OTP.
Existing behavior remains: changing the mobile number resets OTP state.

file_operations.description: Introduce a shared resetOtpState helper (clearing otpRequested, otpVerified, otpCode, demoOtpCode). Keep existing reset behavior for mobile changes, and additionally call resetOtpState whenever selectedBank changes and whenever bankAccountNumber changes (via explicit onValueChange/onChange handlers). Ensure the UI forces a fresh OTP request after any of these changes.

requirements.summary: Adjust OTP helper text to state the demo OTP is tied to the selected bank, without adding real integrations and while keeping existing OTP calls.
acceptanceCriteria: The UI text near the OTP request/entry indicates the OTP is tied to the selected bank (English), while still clearly indicating demo behavior (e.g., “In production, this would be sent via SMS”).
No new third-party/bank/SMS integrations are added; OTP continues to use the existing startOtpChallenge/verifyOtp calls.

file_operations.description: Revise the helper copy near the OTP request/entry area to explicitly indicate the (demo) OTP is associated with the currently selected bank (ideally interpolating the selected bank name when available) while still stating it is a demo and that production would send via SMS. Do not add any new integrations; continue using the existing startOtpChallenge and verifyOtp flows.
